name: scrub-lowering
description: The .scrub/.settle pair (Option G) lowers to four static wire props on Create — __anim.scrub (source spec with defaults filled), __anim.scrubSettle (settle timing), __anim.scrubBind (dotted state path, .bind semantics) and __anim.scrubPoses (materialized [fromValue, toValue] endpoints per pose-overridden prop key) — alongside the node's untouched .states machinery (pose props, synthesized __anim.transition, __anim.states label). The applicators are stripped: no scrub.*/settle.* junk props ever reach the wire, and a state flip still behaves exactly as plain .states

skip.reason: golang: animation protocol not yet implemented

steps.description: Initial render carries the four scrub wire props plus the untouched states machinery
The settle write landing on the bound path flips the pose like any state change
